# Exact-pair demotes for entries sitting on the WRONG reading: modal 得 filed as ˙ㄉㄜ instead
# of ㄉㄟˇ, place-地 filed as ˙ㄉㄜ instead of ㄉㄧˋ, and 還 filed as ㄏㄨㄢˊ where it is ㄏㄞˊ.
# These are dead rows that still occupy keystrokes (還是得 at IJ0_nq blocked 環視的), so they
# are demoted per-pair rather than capped per-phrase, which would also crush the correct row.
# Correct-reading rows for the same words, so each stays typable as a unit. Weight carried
# over from the mis-filed row, raised where needed to beat its own character-by-character path.
# Every reading verified char-by-char against the single-char reading table; the only qstring
# with an existing rival is 三地 at G::_ , where 三諦 still wins.
# Issue #33: keep valid words available, but prevent them from stealing common splits.

# Its split score is -2.114, so a two-syllable phrase needs raw weight < -3.114.
